rows.label: Formula
rows.text:
ΔT_b = K_b m
π = CRT
Δp/p = x₂ (Raoult)

rows.label: Conditions
rows.text: ❌ treat "Conductance of electrolytic solutions" as one blob → ✅ split into: conductance of electrolytic solutions.  ·  ❌ state the rule without its limit → ✅ note when it applies / stops applying.

rows.label: Special cases
rows.text: Colligative properties depend on number of solute particles: relative lowering of vapour pressure Δp/p = x₂ (Raoult).  ·  Boiling-point elevation ΔT_b = K_b m; depression ΔT_f = K_f m; osmotic pressure π = CRT (dilute).
